rules.description: List of relay rules. Each rule defines a source and destination for traffic forwarding, with optional command-line options.

description.description: Optional human-readable description (not used by socat, but helpful for operators).

options.description: List of socat options *before* the first address (e.g., ['-d', '-d', 'fork']).

to.description: Destination address specification (e.g., 'TCP:localhost:9000', 'EXEC:/bin/cat'). Leave empty if only one address is needed (rare).

post_options.description: List of socat options *after* the destination address (e.g., ['socks4a:proxy.example.com:1080']).
